native_result.query: Between 3400 BCE to 3000 BCE, how does the number of monuments and axes changes with elements of symbolic capital?
native_result.HypoA: Between 3400 BCE to 3000 BCE, the number of monuments and axes increases along with symbolic capital
native_result.HypoB: Between 3400 and 3000 BCE, monument count and axes/celts move together, both peaking sharply at 3200 BCE (bin-wise r = +0.87) with axes remaining elevated after the peak while monument count collapses. Over the same window the only informative element of symbolic capital, house size, steps steadily down (Z 2.05 → 0.19), moving opposite to the axes/monument surge — monumental and axe investment intensifies as domestic house-size capital declines. Monument size diverges from this pattern: monument count vs monument size is weakly negative and mixed (r = −0.20; 2 of 4 steps same, 2 opposite), while axes/celts vs monument size shows consistent opposition (r = −0.62; 0 of 3 informative steps same, 1 flat). Taken together — count peaking while size dips at 3200 BCE and size rebounding as count falls — the peak looks like more but smaller monuments, not larger ones (suggestive, not established, given the weak count–size correlation). Prestige-weapon symbolic capital is uninformative in this window (dagger exactly constant at Z = −0.58; hatchets/swords flat at −0.43), so the symbolic-capital co-movement rests entirely on house size. Secondary context: depot finds track monument count (r = +0.85); copper/gold steps down after 3300 BCE. Pollen openness declines concurrently (PC1 MEAN +0.08 → −1.86) and is negatively associated with the axes/monument peak (exploratory; PC1 sign convention undocumented).
native_result.WorkflowB: Loaded and cross-validated the three datasets (capital.csv century-bin Z values verified bit-identical to time_series raw bins after decimal-comma parsing; _inter columns confirmed as pure linear interpolation of the bins). Extracted the 5 complete century bins 3400–3000 BCE as primary data; computed bin-to-bin direction-of-change concordance over the 4 steps for MonumentCount/HouseSize, AxesCelts/HouseSize, MonumentCount/AxesCelts, and the MonumentSize relations; computed descriptive Pearson correlations on the 5-bin trajectories with a leave-out-3200 outlier sensitivity check; joined pollen PC1 MEAN at bin marks as a strictly secondary exploratory series with the sign convention flagged as unknown. All statistics descriptive (n = 5 bins); no significance claims. Corrected statistic attribution in the hypothesis (count–size r = −0.20 mixed; axes–size r = −0.62 consistent opposition); no new analysis required.
